principles: Authorization and field filtering happen before serialization and before counts, facets, relationships, provenance, or comparison are computed.
A presentation profile changes emphasis/order only; it never creates a new canonical identity or grants authority.
Definition, Campaign placement, live instance, playable conversion, and source provenance remain distinguishable layers.
Missing source data stays missing or explicitly recommended; UI completeness is never evidence of source completeness.

Linked abilities, effects, conditions, items, relationships, variants, and provenance open through their owning governed objects instead of being flattened into copied text where stable references exist.

visibility_classes.meaning: Source/governed definition data that the current role is authorized to read.
Campaign-local data explicitly revealed to the current role.
Campaign-local hidden preparation data; never serialized to Player/Observer projections before reveal.
Live-instance state intentionally shared with the current role.
Live hidden runtime state such as unrevealed participants, reserves, secret resources, tactics, or objectives.
Source coordinates, transformation/recommendation status, conflicts, coverage warnings, or validation evidence shown only where role/source policy permits.
User-private notes or data governed by separate ownership; GM/Admin status alone does not automatically grant access.

field_groups.player_projection_rule: Only fields the Player is authorized to know; unrevealed threat ratings, defenses, senses, weaknesses, or exact hidden statistics remain absent.
May be fully, partially, or not revealed according to Campaign/rules policy; absence must not be represented as zero.

field_groups.linked_object_rule: Prefer stable references to owning Ability/Effect/Condition/Action objects and expose a quick Rule Inspector instead of duplicating canonical mechanics.

field_groups.player_projection_rule: Unrevealed weaknesses/immunities are omitted rather than obscured in delivered data.
May be knowledge/discovery gated; authorized known lore can differ from GM source truth without rewriting the source definition.
Player projection shows only revealed statements/relationships/reputation and may represent uncertainty without exposing GM truth.
Visible/equipped items may be revealed independently; unrevealed inventory, loot tables, reward bundles, currency, or hidden equipment remain absent.
Only authorized/known variants are traversable; hidden alternate forms or future stages do not contribute labels/counts.

field_groups.identity_rule: placement_id must never equal or replace source stable ID
instance_id must never replace placement or definition identity

field_groups.source_truth_rule: Recommendation/inference and source text are visually and semantically distinct; Owner Corrected or equivalent authority is never fabricated.

player.diagnostic_policy: source_diagnostic only when authorized and safe; hidden object existence/cardinality must not be inferred from missing/redacted diagnostics

assistant_gm.rule: classes and fields are computed from explicit delegation scope, campaign scope, and expiry; deny by default outside delegation

creator_owner_admin.rule: Campaign/runtime/private classes require separate campaign/user authority despite administrative role

service_ai.rule: operation-specific minimum projection after authorization; no canonical mutation; no hidden state reconstruction; no unknown-source completion as fact

interaction_contracts.rule: Any visible trait/action/ability/effect/condition reference can open a bounded Rule Inspector without losing current Creature/NPC context.
Comparison is read-only, field-labeled, version-aware, authorization-filtered before diffing, and never silently selects a winner.
Quick-add from Library/Inspector creates a provisional or Campaign-local placement through the owning Picker/Scene workflow; source Definition remains immutable.
Variant, summon, faction, relationship, asset, and playable-conversion navigation reauthorizes each target before traversal.
Incomplete, inferred, recommended, source-only, conflicted, or superseded states remain visible to authorized GM/Creator diagnostics and never masquerade as fully sourced data.
HP/resource/condition/initiative changes are runtime actions/events only; editing the Inspector is not an alternate mutation path.

medium: single primary Inspector with secondary drawer
comparison switches between columns and stacked groups
screen_reader: relationship and variant counts only from authorized projection
state and permission text not color-only
high_zoom_reflow: no horizontal requirement for core inspection
reduced_motion: no animated dependency for reveal/variant/section transitions
state change retained through text/static indicator

acceptance_invariants: Hidden creature/NPC existence never appears in search suggestions, counts, facets, relationship counts, variant counts, compare targets, provenance labels, or quick-add options for unauthorized roles.

A Player-safe Inspector cannot reveal a weakness, secret motive, hidden loot, reserve count, unrevealed form, secret relationship, GM tactic, or source diagnostic merely because the GM projection contains it.
Source Definition identity, placement identity, and live instance identity remain distinguishable in every context that shows more than one layer.
Changing presentation profile or responsive layout does not change authority or underlying governed values.
Every inferred/recommended value that is shown as such remains distinguishable from source facts in provenance-capable views.
A source-backed variant chain can be traversed without merging siblings or treating display-name similarity as identity.
An Inspector can render a usable partial object when optional sections are absent without fabricating replacement content.
